errors.description: Button pitch reads slightly tight relative to the drawing. Three internal scale references disagree on magnitude: measured against button diameter the render is ~25% tighter, against placket width ~20% tighter, against below-collar garment length only ~10% tighter (buttons span 71% of the below-collar run vs 79% drawn). Because the drawing's buttons are only ~3 px across, a +/-1 px read swings these ratios by a third, so I state the direction but cannot state the magnitude.
